verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents a first-party Gusto integration with its own setup guide. The integration syncs hiring, onboarding, and equity data so employee information need not be re-entered, and it can automatically grant equity from promises in offer letters, which covers new hires flowing into equity records. missing for 10: evidence that terminations sync into equity records, integrations with other HRIS/payroll systems such as Rippling, details on sync scope and frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration.
